preamble: The vowel a shifts to o through Rounding, Backing. This represents a documented vowel shift pattern.

examples.note: Labial umlaut of *a caused by a second-syllable *o (not *u); Plains Chechen keeps vaša

sources: Schrijver, P. (2021). A history of the vowel systems of the Nakh languages (East Caucasian), with special reference to umlaut in Chechen and Ingush. Languages of the Caucasus 5. https://escholarship.org/uc/item/7gc4x6tv
